pergunta: What health scares did Sam and Evan experience?
ouro: Sam faced a health scare with stomach pains that turned out to be gastritis, prompting him to rethink his health habits. Evan, on the other hand, experienced two separate incidents: a sudden heart palpitation incident and a different event involving a misunderstanding during a medical check-up. These experiences have significantly influenced their perspectives on health and well-being.

candidates.quote: Session date: 1:50 pm on 17 October, 2023 | [D14:1] Sam: Hey Evan! I've been missing our chats. I had quite the health scare last weekend - ended up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Turns out, it was gastritis, which was pretty alarming. It was a wake-up call for me to start prioritizing my health, like adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise. On top of that, my phone's been giving me a hard time, adding to the stress.
